-# SELF-HOSTING SPIKE — the Rust text backend, written in Rian

+# Goal (ADR-0063 §2 backend rung; ADR-0049/0055): emit source text from the Core
+# IR for BOTH text targets `Rian.Lower` serves — Rust and Elixir. The emitter is
+# **precedence-aware**: it threads each node's precedence and adds a paren only
+# when a child binds looser than its context (`Rian.Lower`'s `emit/2 ->
+# {string, prec}` + `p/3`). The precedence/associativity tables are shared across
+# targets; only the operator *spelling* (`disp`/`udisp`) and a few node *shapes*
+# (`if`, tuple, list) differ — exactly the split `Rian.Lower` itself makes. This
+# is the Rian-written counterpart, fixpoint-locked against
+# `Rian.Lower.emit_expr(_, :rust)` AND `(_, :elixir)` in
 # `test/rian/rust_emit_fixpoint_test.exs`.
 #
-# Slice: number/string/identifier literals, prefix unary (`-`/`not`), and binary
-# operators with the full precedence/associativity table. Atoms are BEAM-only
-# (the reference raises on Rust), and calls/lists/structs/prims are the `:partial`
-# tail — see ADR-0063 / docs/self-host-status.md.
+# Slice: literals, prefix unary (`-`/`not`), binary operators (full precedence/
+# associativity), calls, `if`, tuples, and closed lists — for both targets. The
+# `:partial` tail (ADR-0063 / docs/self-host-status.md): dot (Rust `::`-vs-`.`
+# disambiguation), cons-lists (the Rust `to_vec`/insert prepend), structs, `case`,
+# maps, and atoms (BEAM-only on Rust).
 # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
 mod SelfhostRust do
+  # which text target to spell for (the reference's `:rust` / `:elixir` tag).
+  type Target := TRust | TElixir
+
   type Core := CNum(String)
              | CStr(String)
              | CId(String)
              | CUnary(String, Core)
              | CBin(String, Core, Core)
              | CCall(String, Vec(Core))
+             | CIf(Core, Core, Core)
+             | CTuple(Vec(Core))
+             | CList(Vec(Core))
 
   # An emitted fragment with its precedence (the reference's `{string, prec}`).
   struct Em(s String, pr Int53)
 
   def dq(s String) String := "\"" <> s <> "\""
 
   # Operator precedence (the reference `prec/1` table): tighter binds higher.
+  # Target-agnostic — both targets share it.
   def prec(String) Int53
   def prec("*") := 10
   def prec("/") := 10

+  # Binary operator spelling (the reference `disp(_, target)`): only `and`/`or`
+  # differ — Rust `&&`/`||`, Elixir keeps the words; everything else passes through.
+  def disp(String, Target) String
+  def disp("and", TRust) := "&&"
+  def disp("or", TRust) := "||"
+  def disp("and", TElixir) := "and"
+  def disp("or", TElixir) := "or"
+  def disp(other, _) := other
 
-  # Prefix unary spelling.
-  def udisp(String) String
-  def udisp("not") := "!"
-  def udisp("-") := "-"
+  # Prefix unary spelling: Rust `!a`, Elixir `not a` (the word + a space); `-` is
+  # identical. The trailing space on Elixir `not ` is what makes `not a` not `nota`.
+  def udisp(String, Target) String
+  def udisp("not", TRust) := "!"
+  def udisp("not", TElixir) := "not "
+  def udisp("-", _) := "-"
 
   # Wrap a fragment in parens iff it binds looser than the context (`pr < ctx`).
   def paren(e Em, ctx Int53) String

+  # Emit a node to a fragment + precedence (leaf = 12, unary = 11, `if` = 0).
+  pub def emit(Core, Target) Em
+  pub def emit(CNum(t), _) := Em(s: t, pr: 12)
+  pub def emit(CStr(s), _) := Em(s: dq(s), pr: 12)
+  pub def emit(CId(n), _) := Em(s: n, pr: 12)
+  pub def emit(CUnary(op, x), t) := Em(s: udisp(op, t) <> paren(emit(x, t), 11), pr: 11)
+  pub def emit(CBin(op, l, r), t) := bin_em(op, l, r, t)
+  # a call `f(a, b)` binds tightest (prec 12); each argument is a full expression
+  # rendered at context 0 (comma-self-delimited, never parenthesised).
+  pub def emit(CCall(f, args), t) := Em(s: f <> "(" <> args_str(args, t) <> ")", pr: 12)
+  # `if` is prec 0; its cond/then/else render at context 0. Rust uses braces,
+  # Elixir `do … else … end`.
+  pub def emit(CIf(c, th, el), t) := Em(s: if_str(c, th, el, t), pr: 0)
+  # tuple: Rust `(…)`, Elixir `{…}` — prec 12 (a delimited literal).
+  pub def emit(CTuple(es), t) := Em(s: tuple_str(es, t), pr: 12)
+  # closed list: Rust `vec![…]`, Elixir `[…]` — prec 12.
+  pub def emit(CList(es), t) := Em(s: list_str(es, t), pr: 12)
 
   # Left/right context precedences come from associativity; assemble the binary.
-  def bin_em(op String, l Core, r Core) Em
+  def bin_em(op String, l Core, r Core, t Target) Em
     case assoc(op) do
-      "right" -> mk_bin(op, l, r, prec(op) + 1, prec(op))
-      "none" -> mk_bin(op, l, r, prec(op) + 1, prec(op) + 1)
-      other -> mk_bin(op, l, r, prec(op), prec(op) + 1)
+      "right" -> mk_bin(op, l, r, prec(op) + 1, prec(op), t)
+      "none" -> mk_bin(op, l, r, prec(op) + 1, prec(op) + 1, t)
+      other -> mk_bin(op, l, r, prec(op), prec(op) + 1, t)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def mk_bin(op String, l Core, r Core, lc Int53, rc Int53, t Target) Em :=
+    Em(s: paren(emit(l, t), lc) <> " " <> disp(op, t) <> " " <> paren(emit(r, t), rc), pr: prec(op))
+
+  # comma-join rendered children at context 0 (never parenthesised) — the shared
+  # body of call args, tuple/list elements.
+  def args_str(Vec(Core), Target) String
+  def args_str([], _) := ""
+  def args_str([x], t) := paren(emit(x, t), 0)
+  def args_str([x | rest], t) := paren(emit(x, t), 0) <> ", " <> args_str(rest, t)
+
+  def if_str(c Core, th Core, el Core, t Target) String
+    case t do
+      TRust ->
+        "if " <> paren(emit(c, t), 0) <> " { " <> paren(emit(th, t), 0) <> " } else { " <>
+          paren(emit(el, t), 0) <> " }"
+
+      TElixir ->
+        "if " <> paren(emit(c, t), 0) <> " do " <> paren(emit(th, t), 0) <> " else " <>
+          paren(emit(el, t), 0) <> " end"
     end
   end
 
-  def mk_bin(op String, l Core, r Core, lc Int53, rc Int53) Em
-    Em(s: paren(emit(l), lc) <> " " <> disp(op) <> " " <> paren(emit(r), rc), pr: prec(op))
+  def tuple_str(es Vec(Core), t Target) String
+    case t do
+      TRust -> "(" <> args_str(es, t) <> ")"
+      TElixir -> "{" <> args_str(es, t) <> "}"
+    end
   end
 
-  # comma-join the rendered arguments (context 0 — an argument never needs parens).
-  def args_str(Vec(Core)) String
-  def args_str([]) := ""
-  def args_str([x]) := paren(emit(x), 0)
-  def args_str([x | rest]) := paren(emit(x), 0) <> ", " <> args_str(rest)
+  def list_str(es Vec(Core), t Target) String
+    case t do
+      TRust -> "vec![" <> args_str(es, t) <> "]"
+      TElixir -> "[" <> args_str(es, t) <> "]"
+    end
+  end
 
-  # The rendered Rust expression string.
-  pub def render(c Core) String
-    e := emit(c)
+  # The rendered expression string for a target.
+  pub def render(c Core, t Target) String
+    e := emit(c, t)
     e.s
   end
 end
